pl-l4d46c2-d1e115.summary: Quotes Augustine: God's hidden judgment is understood as the punishment by which each is exercised for purgation, moved to conversion, or, if he despises it, blinded to damnation.
claims: Hidden judgment purges, converts, or blinds.

pl-l4d46c2-d1e124.summary: Explains that God's hidden judgment is the punishment by which he judges in purging, converting, or blinding; God's judgments also sometimes mean his dispositions about all things, 'how incomprehensible his judgments'; the judgment he will make in the future is the sentence by which the threshing floor will be winnowed, the good separated locally from the bad by the angels' ministry, the one led to life, the other sent to punishment, who are now mixed together.
claims: God's judgments are hidden punishments, dispositions, or the final sentence.
At the final judgment the good and bad are separated by angels.

pl-l4d46c2.summary: God's hidden judgment, as Augustine says, is the punishment by which each is exercised for purgation, moved to conversion, or, if he despises it, blinded to damnation; God's judgments also mean his dispositions of all things, unsearchable; the future judgment is the sentence by which the threshing floor is winnowed, the good separated from the bad by angels, one led to life, the other sent to punishment.
claims: God's hidden judgment purges, converts, or blinds.
God's judgments also mean his inscrutable dispositions.
The final judgment separates good and bad by the angels' ministry.
